requirements.title: Database Design
requirements.criterion_decision: The deployed relational model has 50 required tables and 84 verified foreign keys, migrated with Alembic and validated read-only under the least-privilege runtime role. Native and hosted constraints, durable reopening, indexes, SQLite/PostgreSQL migration failure/retry and ownership tests pass. Section 162 permits different illustrative table names; this does not accept the separate ORM/security requirement 174.

requirements.title: Data Backup
requirements.criterion_decision: Public backup/verify/fresh-restore tooling covers database, uploaded and generated documents, plus important configuration. The ordinary archive preserves public Compose and non-secret settings; the separate AES-256-GCM companion restores exact private .env/Compose bytes with an independent key. Native SQLite/PostgreSQL recovery decrypts unchanged stored credential ciphertext. Fresh disposable restore and no-clobber/corruption/ownership controls pass. Browser cookies are excluded with documented fresh authentication; no destructive production restore was performed.

requirements.title: Security — Secret Management
requirements.criterion_decision: Provider secrets use profile-bound encrypted server-side storage, masked metadata and private configuration. Allowlisted API exceptions and SQLAlchemy parameter hiding prevent synthetic credential canaries escaping through API, browser or logs. Native credential/cleanup tests, controlled Chromium, PostgreSQL and protected secret scans pass. This accepts the literal secret-management requirement and leaves broader PII/web/database security 171/172/174 open.

requirements.title: Dry-Run Mode
requirements.criterion_decision: The public --dry-run --fixture command executed all 11 current checks from clean delivered source: fresh global/company discovery, changed-profile scoring, real generated documents, Chromium navigation/fill/upload/validation, durable DRY_RUN_COMPLETE and zero final submissions/receipts. Parent-side database/audit/document corroboration and owned process-tree cleanup pass. All inputs and targets are explicitly controlled fixtures.

requirements.title: Direct Employer Route Discovery Before Apply
requirements.criterion_decision: Automatic pre-submission admission attempts fresh bounded employer/ATS resolution, validates current employer/domain/tenant evidence, durably records the resolution status and candidate URL hash, preserves the selected route, and revalidates application/profile/documents, cancellation, consent, policy and caps before claiming submission. Encoded-path ambiguity and shared Workable-host authority regressions pass. An unresolved probe is a completed attempt, not proof of an employer route. External submissions remain OFF; broader database/deadline bounds remain requirement004.

requirements.title: Configuration
requirements.criterion_decision: All 11 original categories have exercised ordinary UI/environment controls: AI, sources, source intervals, company discovery, match thresholds, application rules, application limits, browser profiles, documents, notifications and logging. Controlled browser/component tests and persistent settings behavior pass; seven deployed application services agree with the safe settings readback. No source edit or production user-setting mutation is required. Authenticated public browser observation was unavailable and is recorded separately.

requirements.title: Verification Utility

Source revision and aggregate input digest match before/child/after, both source snapshots are clean, deployed identity stays equal and owned cleanup passes. Runtime readiness and isolated synthetic SQLite/inline functional proof remain separate scopes; Linux correctly blocks the Windows-only retained-process containment path.
